home.title: Teney
home.tagline: This will become the complete knowledge base about Tenerife — beaches, nature, and everything you need to explore the island with confidence.

about.title: Your virtual guide to the island
about.intro: We are a modern company building a product designed to be your virtual guide across Tenerife.
about.p1: Teney brings together reliable place data, practical details, and a calm interface — so planning a day by the ocean or in the mountains feels simple, not overwhelming.
about.p2: We are growing the platform step by step: starting with beaches, then expanding into more places and local knowledge that visitors and residents actually need.
about.p3: Our goal is one trustworthy source about the island — clear, multilingual, and always within reach on your phone or laptop.
